label: rem:sign-sequence-of-braid-remark
title: Multiplicativity and tableau independence of the sign-sequence surreal
html: For each fixed standard tableau t, the sign-sequence surreal assignment \mathrm{surr}(-, t) : B_n \to \mathbf{No} is a multiplicative monoid map: \mathrm{surr}(\beta_1 \beta_2, t) is computed by first applying \beta_2's sign sequence at t to obtain t', then concatenating with \beta_1's sign sequence at t'. Changing the tableau permutes the sign sequence by a Young--Jucys--Murphy permutation. Quotienting by this action gives a tableau-independent functor \widetilde{\mathrm{surr}} : B_n \longrightarrow \mathbf{No} / \sim.
heading: Remark
